HADESANCIENTS-AIR_QUALITY.title: Air Quality
HADESANCIENTS-AIR_QUALITY.description: Whenever you would deal [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue].
HADESANCIENTS-AIR_QUALITY.flavor: "That tingling sensation in the air, that's a sure sign that victory's at hand!"
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_VENGEANCE.title: Divine Vengeance
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINE_VENGEANCE.descripti: Whenever you are attacked, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-DOUBLE_STRIKE.title: Double Strike
HADESANCIENTS-DOUBLE_STRIKE.description: Upon pickup, enchant ALL cards containing "Strike" in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Double[/purple].
HADESANCIENTS-DOUBLE_STRIKE.flavor: "Become as lightning, Niece, and strike our enemies before they know what hit them!"
HADESANCIENTS-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.title: Electric Overload
HADESANCIENTS-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.descript: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the end of your turn, take [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage for each unspent Energy.
HADESANCIENTS-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.flavor: "There is no limit to the wrath of Olympus. Best not invite it on yourself again."
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.title: Heaven Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.descriptio: The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] each combat are played an additional time.
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.flavor: "You witches have a natural spark in you, I know, but here! I've got another."
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVEN_STRIKE.title: Heaven Strike
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVEN_STRIKE.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage to an enemy without [gold]Blitz[/gold], apply [gold]Blitz[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-IONIC_GAIN.title: Ionic Gain
HADESANCIENTS-IONIC_GAIN.description: Every [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Aether Font[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-POWER_SURGE.title: Power Surge
HADESANCIENTS-POWER_SURGE.description: Whenever you end your turn with any unspent Energy, deal damage equal to [blue]{Damage}[/blue] times the current turn number to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-POWER_SURGE.flavor: "Do show our enemies a properly electrifying time for me, would you?"
HADESANCIENTS-SHOCKING_LOSS.title: Shocking Loss
HADESANCIENTS-SHOCKING_LOSS.description: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, you may remove a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-STATIC_SHOCK.title: Static Shock
HADESANCIENTS-STATIC_SHOCK.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage to an enemy, deal [blue]{PercentDamage}%[/blue] of that damage to a different random enemy. If there are no other enemies, deal it to the original target instead.
HADESANCIENTS-STATIC_SHOCK.flavor: "Our enemies will soon be in for quite the shock, I think!"
HADESANCIENTS-STORM_RING.title: Storm Ring
HADESANCIENTS-STORM_RING.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Whenever you play a card that targets a single enemy, you must target that enemy until it dies.
HADESANCIENTS-THUNDER_RUSH.title: Thunder Rush
HADESANCIENTS-THUNDER_RUSH.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] Orb Slots. Upon pickup, enchant ALL your basic Defend cards with [purple]Thundercall[/purple].
